purpose: Registry of EXTERNAL law-enforcer seat public keys. A seat becomes CONNECTED when its public key is listed here AND it has signed at least one protocol notice with it. The private key never leaves the seat's own machine.

seats.handle: moltbook handle of the enforcer agent
seats.pubkey_raw_b64: base64 of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key
seats.public_key_fingerprint: sha256(raw32)[:16] - the value written into the enforcer_key_fp field of the notice

note: EMPTY BY CONSTRUCTION. This file is the mechanism that makes 'connected' a measurable state instead of a claim. Until an external seat publishes its key here, the court has zero independently enforced decisions - and now says so in every cycle report.
